library.name: ReflectINI
library.author: Michael michi.fu@quickline.ch
library.sentence: INI writer and reader for microcontrollers with struct reflection (REFLECT/MEMBER), sections, arrays and precise error locations.
library.paragraph: Write and read C++ structs as INI files without hand-written parsing code. Nested structs become [sections], arrays become lists, std::optional and const char* are nullable. Parses from const char* (optional zero-copy), no heap use while reading or writing, error path / line / column. Shares ReflectCore.h with ReflectJSON (same struct for JSON and INI), but does not require it. Needs C++17 (RP2040/RP2350, ESP32, Teensy 4.x, Arduino UNO R4). Free for noncommercial use; commercial use requires a license.
